Insperity pricing in 2026

Insperity publishes no price for its PEO: the service fee is quoted, and the benefits plans you enrol in are charged on top. The nearest public figures are in its own results: for Q3 2026 Insperity reported revenue of $1,791 and gross profit of $225 per worksite employee per month. Revenue includes the benefits and other costs it bills through to clients, so neither figure is the fee a given client pays. For a published PEO price, Justworks lists PEO Basic at $79 and PEO Plus at $124 per employee per month. Ask Insperity for the service fee separately from premiums and workers' compensation, and how it is calculated.

How the price is built

A PEO bill bundles HR services, payroll and benefits administration with the benefits premiums themselves, so compare the service fee line, not the total, against an HRIS.

What to get priced in writing

  • The service fee, stated separately from benefits premiums and workers' compensation
  • How the service fee is calculated: per employee, or as a percentage of payroll
  • The benefits plans offered and their premiums for your census
  • The contract term and the notice needed to leave

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your Insperity quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

Does Insperity publish its fees?

No. Pricing comes from a consultation and quote. Its quarterly results publish revenue and gross profit per worksite employee per month ($1,791 and $225 for Q3 2026), which describe Insperity's business as a whole, not a client's fee.

What is in an Insperity PEO bill?

A service fee for HR services, payroll and benefits administration, plus the cost of the health and other benefits plans you enrol in, plus workers' compensation. Ask for each as a separate line.

How is the service fee calculated?

Ask Insperity: PEOs charge either per employee per month or as a percentage of payroll, and the two compare very differently as salaries change.

How does Insperity compare with Justworks or TriNet?

Justworks publishes PEO Basic at $79 and PEO Plus at $124 per employee per month; TriNet and Insperity publish nothing. Compare service-fee quotes at your headcount, separately from benefits premiums.
